markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (88%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Stain-degraded frozen section flags reliability, leaving Benign vs InSitu (10%) unresolved [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 88%, InSitu 10%, Normal 2%, Invasive 0% | Low invasive risk; InSitu possible |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% coverage) | Cannot exclude InSitu at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% (flagged) / 98th percentile [F6] | Suspect stain-degraded input; low reliability |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree (false) | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Benign (74%–89% similarity) [F5] | Nearest reference cases match Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.52 contribution) pushes read away from invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 4) · ↓ invasive · Typical score (-0.18 contribution), but 0/20 AI spot-check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 2) · ↓ invasive · Typical score (-0.15 contribution) favors non-invasive read; caption inconsistent [F4] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Average score (-0.13 contribution) pulls slightly away from invasion · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · High score (z = 1.17, -0.10 contribution); 12/20 spot-check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability more than random removal (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (deletion 95% CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); leans on Unreliable mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Stain degradation (severity 3) obscures in situ carcinoma (10%, in conformal set) or focal invasion on frozen section.
- Sectioning misses atypia, foundation models disagree, and disabled HoVer-Net segmentation provides no nuclear measurements.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 9**: Inspect duct-confined atypia and pleomorphism for InSitu vs Benign; consider drafted deeper levels.
2. **Regions 0, 4**: Check highest-risk tile, stromal interface, and mitoses; consider drafted recut H&E section.
3. **Regions 10, 11**: Review inferior (100%) and lateral (81%) margins; defer margin call to permanents [F7].
